text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday to me♪ Come on, you two, 
celebrate, celebrate~♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Happy Birthday to me! —Look at me, saying 
it myself.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Because, because I'm the birthday girl! 
Today I'm the star of the show♪ Right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, then a question for the birthday 
star! Is there any present you have your 
eye on?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
There is!! Really, is it okay!? I saw it 
on Umastagram and I've been dreaming of it 
forever! You see—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...Pancakes? How unexpected. I thought 
you would prefer cakes from a high-end 
shop."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
No no, it's not just regular pancakes! You 
stack a huuuuge pile of tiny ones, and 
it's called the "Burj Khalifa Cake"!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I see, a "Dubai Tower Cake." Making 
something that huge... Fufu, it'll be 
tough, but sounds fun♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Plus, I wanted to make a wish so 
that I could race abroad someday! You two 
understand that longing to race overseas, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...Very well. I shall bake the perfect 
cake for you."
